The Zenni and Chess.com collab just dropped with an exclusive chess-inspired collection of glasses to show your passion for the game in style. Coming in two frames and four colors, they feature all the chess pieces on one arm and "I see five moves ahead" on the other. A custom Chess.com case and lens cloth accompany every pair.

As Chess.com's official eyewear partner, Zenni is also offering an exclusive deal for the chess community. With incremental discounts, you can save up to 25% on any pair you get through Zenni.com/chess from November 16 to December 23. Use code CHESS and enjoy your discount now!

Throughout its more than two decades of existence, Zenni Optical grew to become one of the world's leading online eyewear retailers. Since 2003, the company has sold more than 80 million frames worldwide.

Among its vast collection, you can find single-vision lenses, bifocals, progressives, readers, and sunglasses. Lenses come with scratch-resistant coating and UV protection at no additional cost, with anti-reflective coating as an upgrade option. Zenni frames are lightweight and designed for comfortable wear even beneath headsets—the perfect fit for your next blitz session. You can also preview frames using its virtual try-on, which lets you visualize how a pair of glasses will look on you.

Over the past few years, Zenni has supported chess players and other gamers, including organizations like Team Liquid, currently home to GM Magnus Carlsen. Now, Zenni is ready to support you as you strive to see tactics and spot checkmates while you play on Chess.com!
Check out Zenni's chess glasses and get your pair with a discount now!
